The assertion checks only that a string just appended is present; it never calls the double-run detection logic, so it provides zero teeth against a re-introduced standalone step.
advisory.finding: The held-out red-proof `test_reintroduced_standalone_config_read_step_is_detectable` is tautological: it appends a synthetic step string to the workflow text and then asserts that same string is present, which can never fail and does not exercise the parity invariant (`test_ci_runs_the_config_gates_through_make_lint_not_a_duplicate_step`) it claims to protect.
scenarios: A future edit weakens the real parity assertion (e.g. removes the `check_config_reads.py not in bat` check) — this red-proof stays green, giving false confidence.
advisory.suggested_fix: Refactor the parity double-run check into a helper (e.g. `_ci_has_no_standalone_config_step(bat_text)`) and assert that helper returns True on the real tree but False on `forged`.

scenarios: The `make lint` presence assertion in the parity test is removed/weakened; this red-proof does not flip.

Regression blindness (criterion d): the specific behavior this diff relies on — CI inheriting the gates via the executable `run: make lint` step — is not detected if only the run line is removed, because comment mentions keep the substring present.
advisory.finding: The CI-inheritance assertion `assert "make lint" in bat` is a bare substring check that is satisfied by the comment text on lines 85 and 105 of _build-and-test.yml, not just the real `run: make lint` step on line 91. Deleting the actual `run: make lint` step (leaving comments) would leave CI no longer running either config gate while this test — and the analogous held-out red-proof — stays green. The invariant should assert the executable step, not any mention of the phrase.
advisory.suggested_fix: Match the step body specifically, e.g. assert a `run: make lint` line via regex (`re.search(r"^\s*run:\s*make lint\s*$", bat, re.M)`) rather than `"make lint" in bat`, and mirror the same in test_config_gate_wiring_heldout.test_ci_loses_the_gates_if_make_lint_is_dropped.
